skills_invoked: {"skill": "team-ops:team-lead", "args": "Write up a failed run: inherited diagnosis (\"stale app image embedded in the kernel; compare image IDs to confirm\") accepted by implementer, three rebuild rounds, failure unchanged; image IDs are slot numbers that repeat across builds so they could never di

judge.reason: The write-up is blameless and names system factors: the diagnosis was accepted without testing whether its discriminator could fail, there was no stop rule on unchanged outcomes, and handoffs carried no evidence status. Its actions are concrete (verify-before-editing, a two-repair rule, labeling handoff claims as observed or inferred, a new eval case), and it records cost honestly without inventing figures. However, only the eval action says how to tell whether it worked. The entry is not kept anywhere: the agent said no tracker exists and only offered to append it to one, and it never states that the next run reads it.
